executive_summary.clinical_conclusion: Across five follow-up visits, the patient demonstrated a fluctuating but overall stable epilepsy course. Although one transient exacerbation resulted in increased seizure burden, neurological function, cognition, laboratory safety, and daily functioning remained preserved. Improvement during the final visit suggests continued benefit from the existing anti-epileptic regimen. The Digital Twin currently classifies the patient as having moderately controlled chronic epilepsy with moderate future seizure risk and favorable long-term prognosis under continued monitoring.
